From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Cc: accounting@redwood.com

Subject: Ledger synchronization checkpoint — action items for EOW close

Team,

We have one business day left before the quarter cutoff for finance to lock recognizing events. This note pulls together a short checklist and the fields I need updated by end of day tomorrow so accounting can ingest final invoices and POs without rework. I attached the latest ledger_sync_v3.xlsx with the two tabs we care about: "Pending Recognitions" and "PO / Doc Status."

Top asks (please reply inline with status):
- ACME Corp (RDW-2329): confirm signed PO uploaded and expected invoice date. If PO exists, add PO number to the ledger row and drop the PDF into the Drive folder.
- NimbusTech (prospect-stage): we have verbal commit. Need legal to confirm contract counter-signed OR flag to push to next quarter.
- All deals marked "Stage: Legal" — update stage to either Closed-Won (if signatures present) or Stalled (if waiting for PO/CLA).
- Owners: verify MRR/one-time split and final billing contact.

Quick guidance: any deal without a matching PO/Doc by COB tomorrow will be excluded from this quarter's recognized revenue. If you're blocked by an external approver, paste the name and timestamp of your outreach.

Attachments: [attachment: ledger_sync_v3.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)]

Thanks — I'll run a reconciliation pass at 10:30am tomorrow PT and again at 3:30pm. If you cannot meet the window, escalate to David.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

2) NimbusTech — if legal can't get the counter-signed SOW in time, mark as "Delayed" and we will not recognize this quarter. Don't let it sit in limbo.
